capability.claim: Recursively search a directory for a regex pattern, respecting gitignore rules, quickly.
capability.task: Find where a named symbol is referenced in a codebase.
capability.conditions: Requires a directory of source text; no language or symbol awareness.

comparison.comparator: graft callers symbol-level caller lookup over a prebuilt wiring graph.
comparison.baseline: Textual pattern hits versus structural who-calls-this answers.

target.scopeRationale: Surface overlap only on locating references to a symbol; ripgrep does not model call structure.

preliminaryEvidence.summary: README describes line-oriented regex search; it makes no symbol, call-graph or caller-resolution claim.

limitations: Similarity is lexical (shared code-search vocabulary), not a like-for-like task.
No experiment is run for this lead; triage rejected it.

independentTest.proposal: None run: rejected at triage. If reopened, define a caller-recall protocol with reviewed ground truth before any run.

disposition.rationale: Weak similarity: ripgrep is a general text search tool, not a symbol or call-graph retriever, so it is not a challenger to the codebase-graph-retrieval capability.
disposition.nextAction: Record the triage rejection; no experiment, no admission.
